title: Community ports of Neolume
description: Registry of apps built from docs/SPEC.md for other TVs. PORTS.md and the website section are generated from ports.json by tools/spec_gen.js (npm run spec). Only links – no binaries are hosted here.

name.description: Name of the port. Must not contain 'Plex' and must not imitate the official app.

reference.description: Only for the reference implementation in this repository (always counts as built against the current spec).

models.description: Tested models or model years, e.g. 'OLED C1 (2021)'.

os.description: TV operating system and version, e.g. 'webOS 6.0', 'Google TV (Android 12)'.

url.description: Link to the port's repository or releases page (https).

specVersion.description: App/spec version of docs/SPEC.md the port was built against (shown at the top of SPEC.md).

maintainer.description: GitHub handle of the maintainer, without @.

lastVerified.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the port was last checked to work.

features.description: Status per Part A section of SPEC.md (A1 … A19).

notes.description: Optional short note (not shown in the table).
